text:
Type: low white wooden shelf tower
Use: storing towels, baskets and toiletries, side shelf beside a bed or sofa; bathroom, bedroom, living room
Style: farmhouse, traditional, classic
Materials: white stained solid wood frame, painted panel shelves, slatted base shelf
Colors: white, warm soft white
Shape: square open stand with a thick overhanging top, four straight legs, two open shelves above a slatted bottom shelf, open on every side, compact and light
Feel: tidy, homely, fresh, calm
Goes with: pale wood, white tiles, cotton towels, rattan; farmhouse, cottage or classic rooms

product.name: HEMNES
product.description: The open shelves give an easy overview and easy reach.
